changes.before: Run any model with an Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax) — even your Codex subscription — as real Claude Code workflows, agent-team teammates, or one-shot subagents, driven exactly like native ones. Your main session's own auth is untouched (OAuth subscription or API key, either works); API-key providers bill the provider key via apiKeyHelper, while a Codex subscription bills through a local OAuth daemon — each worker receives its credential on demand, never through its env or argv. Teammates need the terminal `claude` inside tmux or iTerm2 (not the desktop app) and a one-time `cc-fleet teammate setup`. Requires the `cc-fleet` binary on PATH, installed separately.
